whiteOnlyDiffAudit.conclusion: The white-only change cannot produce an additional world/hull event and did not alter the capital velocity constants or player weapon clocks.

capitalSpeed.classification: MEASURED native event cadence plus source-derived eight-scanline displacement
capitalSpeed.decision: The reported capital-speed increase was not reproduced and is not present in the white-only runtime diff.

fighterToCapital.sequence: outgoing OPEN iteration starts in host frame 1054, waits through $77 in 1055; first capital iteration waits at $70 and starts in 1056
fighterToCapital.physicalTickResult: ACTIVE_GAMEPLAY_FRAME, projectile movement, world/hull and effects have no producer call in host frame 1055; the owner-PASS burst/audio helpers alone consume their skipped tick

capitalToFighter.sequence: COMPLETE iteration and first OPEN iteration both start in host frame 2140
capitalToFighter.physicalTickResult: frame_counter/active-gameplay and the player-projectile update enter twice in host frame 2140; fire and world updates enter twice in host frame 2141 as the first OPEN iteration crosses VBI

nativeTransitionTrace.origin: The mixed OPEN $77 publication and capital $70 frame-start cadence entered this path at f6eee5ce, before the white-only starfield commits.

worldRing.detail: STAR_NEAR_RING_ADVANCED is a consumer-side bitfield. Star coarse sets bit 1; the authoritative world step ORs bit 0 after it has already decided to rotate exactly once.

fireCadence.classification: MEASURED current linked XEX, instruction-exact, 6000 calls per mode and movement, four movement patterns
fireCadence.conclusion: The burst state machine itself remains deterministic and sector-independent. Its existing entry helper does not make the other gameplay domains physical-frame exact.

projectileMovement.classification: MEASURED instruction-exact routine plus native call clocks
projectileMovement.physicalCadenceIssue: The routine is called once per main-loop iteration, not once per latched PAL VBI. It therefore inherits the entry hole and exit duplicate/split described by the native transition trace.

starReentry.firstRenderWrites: same transition iteration, host frame 2140 at scanlines 285-288
starReentry.exactDelay: zero extra logical iterations; one next-display fetch, at most one PAL frame
starReentry.cause: intentional capital cache invalidation followed by safe late publication after the playfield has passed

regression.note: A broader 56-test selection also exposed 11 existing stale capital-hull/runtime-timing fixture assertions against older display-list lengths, hashes and source labels. They were not changed or counted as proof for this docs-only audit.

rootCause.capitalSpeedObservation: No current-code regression: rates and native event cadence are identical to the pre-white candidate.
rootCause.shotTimingObservation: The movement kernel is stable, but the pre-existing mixed $77/$70 sector anchors do not provide one physical-frame tick to every subsystem at both handoffs.
rootCause.starReturnObservation: A separate intentional one-fetch publication delay, not a shared-clock stall.

fix.reason: A local star-phase change cannot affect the proven handoff. Extending the existing burst/audio catch-up to projectiles, collision, world, effects and lifecycle would duplicate partial gameplay at a raster-sensitive point. Correcting both boundaries requires a dedicated authoritative physical-frame latch/anchor proof or a scheduler re-alignment, which exceeds this task's minimal-fix stop condition.

decision: No single white-star timing regression explains the owner observations. Capital speed is unchanged; the player movement complaint exposes an older cross-sector frame-domain defect, while star re-entry is a separate publication/visual behavior.
next: Owner decision on a dedicated mixed-$77/$70 sector-handoff master-clock proof; owner smoke capital speed + player shot timing only after that proof produces a runtime candidate.
